title: WP900 G10 target promotion must bind real source/trial process topology across process-local factory seals
target: F2-WP-900 generation 10 independent semantic mediator authority candidate

material_observation.logical_identity_gap: Current G10 repository tests create source_process_identity and trial_process_identity as distinct caller-supplied strings while source mediator construction and MediatedSemanticState.from_wire execute in the same pytest OS process. Only execute_mediated_reentry_only launches an actual child process. RuntimeObservationIdentity.process_identity is likewise harness-supplied text and is not independently bound by the ABI to an OS PID/process-start identity.
material_observation.factory_seal_boundary: G10 factory validity uses module-local object() sentinels and identity comparison (_factory_seal is token). The seal is intentionally omitted from serialized wire/as_dict surfaces. Therefore an exact factory-valid mediator/state object cannot itself serve as a portable cross-process authority proof: after a real source -> trial process boundary, the receiving process cannot reconstruct or validate the originating process-local seal merely from the serialized packet.
material_observation.false_green_risk: A target harness could report four distinct source/trial identity labels and fresh executor child PIDs while source and trial mediation still occur in one OS process. Conversely, a same-process repository repair that requires an exact factory-valid mediator receipt may close the self-forgery regression yet still be structurally incapable of proving the later distinct-process target claim.

constructive_counterexample.setup: Run the current G10 helper pattern in one OS process, assign source-process:g10:N and trial-process:g10:N strings for each trial, construct source receipts and trial states in that same process, and launch only the behavioral executor as a subprocess.
constructive_counterexample.expected_current_behavior: The crossover accepts the four distinct source identity strings, four distinct trial identity strings, disjoint identity sets and four fresh child PIDs even though no source-to-trial OS process boundary was exercised.
constructive_counterexample.required_behavior: Repository acceptance may remain candidate-only, but any later VPS/target promotion claiming independent source/trial mediation must bind identities to independently observed runtime process instances and prove the exact source -> condition-blind trial-wire -> trial -> executor path across the real process boundaries.

required_discriminator_before_vps_bindin: Keep the current G10 VPS subject unbound until the wire-sidechannel and self-authenticating-origin repairs are green and independently reviewed.

Do not use distinct caller-supplied process_identity strings as evidence of process independence. Bind source and trial to independently observed OS/runtime identities, at minimum stable process-instance evidence sufficient to distinguish PID reuse (for example PID plus process-start/namespace/boot binding or an equivalent external runtime identity).

Add a regression/runtime harness proving source mediator construction and trial wire admission execute in distinct process instances, with the behavioral executor in a third fresh process where that is the intended topology.

Separate verifier-only attestation from trial-visible semantic transport. If repository admission requires a process-local factory-valid receipt, treat that only as repository origin validation; define an external cross-process attestation/readback mechanism for target execution rather than pretending the in-memory seal crossed processes.

Require exact-source and boot binding for all observed process instances and preserve the process-topology evidence in the target receipt before any semantic_mediator_authority_candidate or semantic-GWT promotion.
scope_fence: This packet creates no successor generation, does not mutate terminal G9, and does not claim a current target-runtime product failure because no G10 VPS subject is bound. It blocks only any future interpretation that logical identity labels or process-local factory seals prove the required independent source/trial target topology. All G10 higher credits remain zero.
next_exact_action: Active G10 owner should repair the trial-visible wire and source-origin admission first, then add externally bound source/trial/executor process-instance evidence before freezing any VPS subject. Repository same-process factory validation alone must not be promoted as target process independence.
